facts.fact: The Partnership Compact of March 2023 says MINEDUC is operationalising a system for monitoring absenteeism, especially in public schools, through which teachers and headteachers can detect students at risk of dropping out or repeating; it is not yet described as in use and no school level or count is given.

The Partnership Compact says MINEDUC is using the GPE System Capacity Grant (US$1,177,715, January 2023 to February 2024, grant agent UNICEF) to operationalise the system for monitoring absenteeism; no domestic budget line for it is stated.

The 2023-2027 Partnership Compact, endorsed by MINEDUC and the Education Sector Working Group in March 2023, lists developing and implementing an Early Warning System for dropout and repetition among its interventions and sets the number of schools implementing it as a monitoring indicator.
